style: Technical: colored pencil and gouache on ivory, muted green, blue and ochre. Diaries: impressionist oil painting, muted greens and slate blue, warm light. Landscape 3:2, no frame, watermark or prose.

images.subject: A small illustrated workshop where connected clusters of wooden graph nodes are joined into a branching reconstruction tree. Clear nodes and thin connecting edges, with clustered components at the bottom and merged parent nodes above. A tiny pencil-wielding robot arranging the connections. No numbers or labels.

A charming small robot mathematician arranging rows of binary tiles (only 0 and 1) on an ivory workbench. Three independent colored rows combine into a fourth row, evoking Gaussian elimination and XOR. Loose floating binary tiles and a simple vector-arrow motif. Do not present a formal equation that could be mathematically wrong.

A tiny courier robot tracing a single ochre route through a network of forest-green circular nodes and fine blue-gray edges. Several alternative routes are muted; the chosen continuous route is clearly highlighted between two larger endpoints. A playful graph-algorithm illustration, not a city or landscape. No edge numbers.

An illustrated binary segment tree made of connected small wooden tiles above a row of eight contiguous array blocks. Parent brackets group contiguous halves and quarters; one interval of blocks is highlighted ochre. A tiny robot librarian points at the grouped blocks. The tree is the primary subject; no text or numbers.

Two little robots assembling colored state tiles from two child tree nodes into a single parent node above them. Clearly visible binary-tree connections and matching small grids of tiles at each node; merging partial computations. Friendly editorial algorithm illustration, no text or formal equations.

A curious little robot at a workbench watching a complex teal wave split into three simple sinusoidal ribbons, with a small row of vertical frequency bars to the right. Clear signal-processing motifs: waves, components, spectrum. No numbers, labels or equations.
A quiet Hanoi-inspired lakeside at winter dusk, a bare branch and tiny warm windows across the water; reflective, wistful, with room for a new beginning. No identifiable people.
An open unmarked notebook beside a window overlooking a softly painted Vietnamese city street at morning, a small cup of tea; hopeful and intimate, no readable writing.
